tokenizer_disclaimer.humanReadable: Bucket totals for uncachedSystemPrompt, history, toolOutputs, systemPromptCached, agentsMdCached, mcpToolSchemasCached, accumulatedHistoryCached, accumulatedToolOutputsCached, unclassifiedCached, toolOutputsByTool, subagentDispatchByAgent are tiktoken (cl100k_base) estimates derived from a proportional split of opencode's authoritative session.tokens_input; they are relative-only and suitable for ranking cost drivers, but are NOT billing-grade absolute counts. The three buckets nevertheless sum exactly to opencode's stored tokens_input value (last bucket absorbs rounding). Authoritative buckets (cachedRead, cachedWrite, output, reasoning, subagentDispatch) are read directly from opencode and require no estimation. Supported opencode version range: >=0.18.0 <0.30.0.
tokenizer_disclaimer.sumCorrectnessGuarantee: Uncached sub-buckets sum exactly to opencode.session.tokens_input
